definition.def: A previous event or thing is one that happened or existed before the one that you are talking about.
examples: I'm a lot happier than I was in my previous job.

definition.def: You refer to the period of time or the thing immediately before the one that you are talking about as the previous one.
examples: It was a surprisingly dry day after the rain of the previous week.
He recalled exactly what Bob had told him the previous night.
